text:
Priya K: Hey team — I just finished the HR steps but can't get into HubSpot. SSO redirects me to the company login and then I get an error: "403 - Access denied". Anyone who can grant the CRM seat?

Marta (IT): @Priya K can you paste the exact error URL and your employee id? I can check SSO logs.

Priya K: Sure — error link: https://auth.redwood.example/err/403?ctx=hubspot - emp id: RWF-2345

onboarding-bot: Welcome @Priya K! You've been added to the #sales channel and assigned the Sales Onboard checklist.

Jon S: Priya — I provision HubSpot seats from Sales Ops. Marta — if SSO is blocking, we can send an invite link that skips SSO temporarily. Priya, check your inbox for an invite from ops@redwood.ai in ~5m.

Marta (IT): Got it. I see a failed authentication from your account, looks like your SSO account wasn't linked to HubSpot yet. I raised a ticket and linked the emp id. Ticket: IT-9823. I'll follow up after I map your id to the HubSpot SAML group.

Priya K: Thanks. If the invite link works, is there any setup I should do for Dialpad and Gong while I wait?

Jon S: Yes — Dialpad and Gong are separate. Dialpad should auto-provision once your email is in the sales group. If not, ping devops-dialpad. For Gong: go to https://app.gong.io/signup and use SSO or the invite. I'll paste the Dialpad quick-setup snippet below.

Jon S: ```
Dialpad onboarding steps:
1) Accept invite in email
2) Install Dialpad desktop app (Settings > Downloads)
3) Update Caller ID to +1-415-555-0199 (team shared)
4) Set voicemail greeting: keep under 20s
```

Elaine: Welcome Priya!! :tada: We put our SDR playbook here — https://redwood.docs/sales/onboarding/SDR-playbook — focus on the 7-step call guide and the objection cheat sheet for week 1. Ben H will be your buddy for shadowing.

Ben H: Happy to help — I'll schedule 2 shadow sessions tomorrow at 10am and 3pm PT. Priya, share your calendar availability and I'll send invites.

Marta (IT): Quick update — I mapped your SAML attributes and pushed a test. You should be able to SSO into HubSpot now. If you still get 403, clear cookies or try incognito.

Priya K: I tried incognito and it worked! I see HubSpot now. Thanks Marta and Jon. 

Jon S: Great. Follow-up checklist for Priya: [x] HubSpot access, [ ] Dialpad install, [ ] Gong access, [ ] Calendar shares for shadow sessions. Ping me if Dialpad doesn't auto-provision.

onboarding-bot: Ticket IT-9823 updated: SAML mapping completed by Marta.

Elaine: One more — here's a short script excerpt to use on first call (feel free to tweak):
"Hi, this is Priya from Redwood Inference. We're helping teams run LLM inference reliably at scale. Quick question — are you responsible for inference or model serving in your stack?"

Priya K: Thanks all — I'll reply here once Dialpad/Gong are done. Appreciate the quick help! :heart:

Ben H: Welcome aboard again! :raised_hands:

(END OF THREAD)
